name: Probation ends on the 14th: 85% of the position's salary before, the whole after
source: synthetic — replace with anonymised real cases
derivation: The structure holds the position's salary, 20,000,000, and a probation share of 85%; the probation contract covers 1-14 August 2026, so the month has two segments: 1-14 (10 working days, on probation) and 15-31 (12 working days), 22 in all, every one paid.
On probation days the month's figure is 85% of the position's: 20,000,000 x 85 / 100 = 17,000,000.
Each segment is pro-rated on its own and rounded on its own:
The insurance base follows the terms in force at the end of the period (rule last_segment): 20,000,000. Employee insurance 1,600,000 + 300,000 + 200,000 = 2,100,000.
